note: Small RV park beside a lodge at the south edge of Leeds, right off US-2 between Devils Lake and Rugby, across the street from a gas station and store. Highway noise. --Claude
summary: Operator page read in full: 14 back-in FHU spaces (1-6 30 A, 7-14 30/50 A), $40/night (under the gate; no gateway needed), weekly/monthly offered, shower in the lodge entry, utilities ~May to mid-Oct, reserve by phone/text or Hipcamp, otherwise FCFS self check-in. Google 4.7/62. RV sites are the main product, not a lodge afterthought; reviews are mostly one- or two-night travellers. Keep. Pin is on the wrong side of US-2 (~195 m).
flags: LODGE-AFTERTHOUGHT TEST: passes. The operator page gives the RV park its own section (14 numbered full-hookup spaces with amperage by site number, rates, season, self check-in); the lodge (sleeps 14, $275/night, weekly-only in waterfowl season) is a separate product.

LONG-STAY: weekly ($250) and monthly ($750) rates and 'Long term stay customers must have and use self contained/functional shower and toilet system'. Google reviews read are travellers ('We stopped for 1 night on our way home from Alaska', 'Nice place to stop for a one or two nights'; one guest paid '$36/night based on a weekly rate'); a 1-star review mentions 'those workers that camped here'. No wording discourages nightly guests; nightly share looks high. Keep.
PRIVATE GATES: Google 4.7 / 62 (passes); price $40 (under $50); presence = working website with phone (passes).

PIN MOVE (~195 m, recommended though under 250 m because it is on the wrong side of US-2): stored 48.28297,-99.43785 is south of US-2 by the grain bins and lagoons; the lodge and its lawn are north of the highway, west of the street opposite the gas station: ~48.2846,-99.4388 (Google 48.28482,-99.43923; operator's own Google link 48.2847189,-99.4392147).
